name: What should a properly framed partition wall actually do for my space?
description: A good partition wall should be straight, secure, and ready for drywall and trim. It should divide the space cleanly without future settling or visible defects.

mainEntity.name: What should a properly framed partition wall actually do for my space?

acceptedAnswer.text: A properly framed partition wall creates a clean new room division and a solid base for drywall, trim, and doors. If the framing is square and secure, the finished wall will look straight and perform better over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good partition wall should be straight, secure, and ready for drywall and trim. It should divide the space cleanly without future settling or visible defects.
